ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels covering approximately 95% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the distal tips and scattered circular points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white clusters located at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Numerous scattered circular white spots (diameter approximately 5-15 pixels) distributed across the central and left lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the center-point with a sharp convergence angle dividing the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration across the entire trailing edge with high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks and valleys, transitioning to high-amplitude irregular clusters at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature on both the left and right lobes leading to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density circular white pixel clusters visible on the left lobe's upper quadrant and scattered across the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal linear disruption visible on the right lobe near the median notch; several horizontal linear marks on the lower left lobe near the water line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-intensity irregular mass clusters at both distal tips consistent with barnacle colonization. Numerous circular de-pigmented scars distributed across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy encrustation at the lateral edges of both lobes creating an irregular, lumpy 2D profile against the sky background.
